stateCombinations.description: Restore a forced-termination session, visibly activate every dormant role tab, and prove isolated cookie and LocalStorage continuity for all three tabs.
Inject a duplicate native cookie checkpoint key before restart and prove visible workspace launch restores one deterministic isolated cookie session while LocalStorage remains native-store-owned.

Write distinct late LocalStorage markers through visible page buttons in one two-role workspace, close and reopen through visible UI, then prove both native role stores remain persistent and isolated across process restart.

Launch Roles and overlapping Role Workspaces through the visible Quick Open destination menu, then launch one Web-only Workspace successively into a new window, a live permanent window, and a dormant saved window without duplicating source ownership or synthesizing Role ownership for Web content.
Mutate a mixed Role and Workspace native tab topology while a macro is active, then persist its fenced state before exact-PID forced termination.
Fail a shared Role ownership claim, retain its live surface and placeholders, terminalize its multi-role macro, require a manual role restart, and leave unique Roles running.
Restore a mixed Role and Workspace topology with exact active, hidden, order, ownership, and isolated session state while keeping pre-crash macros terminal.

journeys.description: Accept legal documents, dismiss first-run setup, and reach the application shell.
Navigate every primary feature from the real application shell.
Use the labeled game-name field to validate, create, edit, persist, and delete a custom game through the UI.

Open Quick Open from the visible sidebar, main-window shortcut, and an actual managed game WebView; verify the game never receives K, Escape restores the exact source tab, successful actions retain their destination focus, then verify pin/recent persistence and clearing.
Use the labeled role-name field to create and persist a role, then launch it through Quick Open against the deterministic fixture.
Use the labeled workspace-name field to create a role-backed workspace, persist it, and exercise its UI launch admission.

Create a mixed Web App and Role workspace through visible slot-content controls, choose a popular-site menu option, override its editable details with the fixture URL, launch its paired content and external Rion-owned chrome System WebViews, drag the visible native divider with a real platform pointer, and verify the authoritative mixed layout plus configured HTTP(S) start URL and Rion-managed Web session persist across restart; contained fullscreen behavior is covered by WORKSPACE-WEB-FULLSCREEN-005.

Trigger Workspace Web contained fullscreen from visible fixture controls using real platform keyboard input, prove the element and content WebView expand to the slot envelope while the sibling chrome surface hides and native sibling/window geometry remains unchanged, restore through both the website exit control and Escape, and repeat the same bounded behavior in its controlled popup.

Create a single Web App Workspace through visible controls, gate navigation to prove Loading then Ready with empty Role IDs and Role slots, complete persisted Web workspace slots, native content plus Rion-owned chrome, shared Web session continuity, no synthetic Role status, and repeated-launch deduplication; then inject a navigation failure, close and reopen the degraded tab through visible native controls, and restore the saved Web-only tab after process restart on macOS and Windows.
Create, rename through the labeled standard input, and open a permanent Game Window from the visible Game Windows route.

Toggle the fullscreen-toolbar preference through the visible macOS View menu or Windows Settings switch, use the visible macOS fullscreen control or Windows fullscreen shortcut plus real pointer movement to prove the Game Window tab row is off screen over live role content when auto-hide is selected, reveals with native window controls at the macOS screen edge, remains pinned when always-show is selected, updates immediately in both directions, and restores its persisted baseline after restart.

Create a role-assigned macro, verify Ctrl/Command+K is rejected with the dedicated reserved-shortcut message, prove its mind-map focus remains stable without node or focused-edge filters, exercise grouped/flat table behavior and selection, then start and stop it from the UI.
Start a visible macro action and prove its exact native key plus left, middle, and right click effects in the assigned System WebView role.

Start a one-shot toggle macro whose first iteration keeps Digit2 held until stop, first from target Role A and then from shortcut-source Role B while A is hidden; switch visibly A to B and back to A, operate B, and prove A's trusted consumer hold is restored after Windows focus or visibility loss, B receives no Digit2, and no failed, recovering, or restart-required state appears.

Launch a mixed three-slot Workspace containing two Roles and one Web App, wait for both real Roles to reach authoritative macro readiness, show one looping macro exactly once in its combined two-role group, run it across both Roles with balanced iterations through a visible focus change, then keep a toggle macro's Digit2 held on Role A while focusing and operating Role B and stop it from B without deadlock or lost consumer state.

From visible role content, open and complete a local cross-origin verification iframe while a zero-interval looping macro runs; prove automatic input pauses before native submission, the live document/session and surface generation remain unchanged, and the eligible root restarts once from the beginning when Canvas focus returns. Then inject a page-finish failure to prove a genuinely unresumable role keeps its live surface and becomes restart-required.

Use the native lifecycle test signal to suspend and resume while a hidden-role macro owns a key; prove the old run terminates, cleanup releases input, starts remain fenced until the exact lifecycle and input epochs recover, and the user can restart without selecting the hidden tab. On Windows, first place WebView2 in an exact TrySuspend state, prove Focus readiness resumes it, and inject failed and indeterminate Resume outcomes without native input.

Capture the original Shift+2 main-key lifecycle, replay exactly one trusted balanced Shift+2 chord through the selected role's native input lane, and dispatch its macro only after the guarded DOM acknowledgement; then send Shift+1 and prove the page has no residual key ownership or recursive macro start, and trigger Shift+3 to verify consecutive managed shortcuts remain non-recursive.

Keep an exact physical Shift side held across managed while-held acknowledgements and Game Window focus loss; prove focus return reasserts that same still-held side so an unbound Shift+4 remains shifted until physical release, with no Core lease or page key left behind.

Use visible native middle-button presses in selected roles to exercise toggle and while-held macros while proving mousedown, mouseup, and auxclick remain intercepted from the page; then execute left, middle, and right macro click steps and observe all three trusted native button effects without recursively re-entering the shortcut.

Hold unbound keys while switching roles and focusing the main app; prove the original role receives one release, a Shift released outside the Game Window does not affect the next Digit4 after refocus, and no pressed or consumer codes remain.

Keep a one-shot parent visibly stoppable after it triggers a looping child, stop the owned group through the parent's visible Stop action, and terminalize independent loops through native tab close, native window close, and application shutdown while proving input fences and final-flush cleanup.
Activate three ready tabs through visible native controls and retain one selected, focused, visibility-consistent surface per tab across close and dormant reopen.

Open two same-origin roles in one workspace, write distinct late LocalStorage markers through visible page buttons, prove native-store continuity after visible close/reopen and process restart, inject a duplicate Windows cookie checkpoint key, then clear only role A while role B remains intact.

Launch two workspaces into separate Game Windows with one shared role, wait for the second native WebView batch, prove the source role remains controller-visible, parented to its original host, and page-interactive, then press the blocked visible placeholder in the second workspace and prove exact ownership transfer without disturbing either independent role.

Change theme and Game Window behavior through Preferences, change in-game macro interface visibility through Interface settings, verify macro execution remains available, and confirm all preferences persist after restart.

Fence native placement, presentation, and tab/control geometry across resize and maximize; prove the active Windows role host and WebView2 controller fill the exact client workspace after initial launch and close/reopen; prove the active tab shows its native loading status while navigation is gated and hides it only after the authoritative ready event; verify visible Game Window chrome remains draggable, minimizable, and closable after role content becomes ready; preserve tab-strip bounds while minimized; and preserve persistence, clean restart, and forced termination by generation and revision.

Open isolated Roles and overlapping Role Workspaces through Quick Open destination menus, then visibly route a Web-only Workspace through new, live, and dormant Game Windows, prove its runtime and persisted Role slots remain empty and its selected Windows controller remains visible and parented to the destination host, and use primary actions to focus rather than duplicate repeated sources.

Use real native tab drag and visible context-menu actions to reorder, move, detach, hide, and reveal Role and Workspace tabs before crash recovery; detach a selected Role while its source retains a successor, then drag differently sized source and target windows and verify Windows keeps every WebView2 controller in its current root with an exact DOM viewport bound and no failed geometry receipt; also verify minimize/restore preserves those bounds without a resize event.
Keep a macro attached to shared Role identity through successful ownership transfer while blocking input to non-target and placeholder occurrences.

Restore mixed Role and Workspace topology and isolated sessions, keep crashed macros terminal, and preserve a failed shared ownership claim without late input or automatic surface recovery until manual restart.
Choose a workspace layout through its visible menu, then exercise destructive confirmations and reverse-dependency cleanup through the visible UI.
Launch three role tabs, preserve active, dormant, ordered topology across native window generations, and visibly admit each dormant tab during recovery.
Distinguish clean exit from exact-PID forced termination, recover without corrupting persisted state, and verify isolated cookie and LocalStorage continuity in every restored role tab.

Force-terminate a multi-window last-visible session, restore it through the Dashboard, visibly activate and verify every restored role tab, force-terminate again, discard through the Dashboard, and retain clean dormant definitions on the next restart.

Verify the macOS-only high-refresh selector defaults to Disabled and remains visibly selectable in Preferences (and verify its Windows absence), Interface font previews and override-warning placement, Data transfer, event-bound performance diagnostics and cancellation, update, and legal entry points plus their non-destructive cancel boundaries.
Cross real mixed-scale displays and preserve logical placement plus selected WebView2 controller visibility, parent-host attachment, and non-zero bounds through fullscreen and maximized transitions.

Edit Role, Workspace, and Macro definitions, choose a Workspace layout through its visible menu, persist Role and Workspace pointer reorder, and exercise cross-domain bulk deletion through visible UI.

Launch a two-role Workspace through UI, retain the healthy role and failed live surface through a controlled navigation failure, require a visible stop-and-relaunch instead of automatic surface recovery, and cancel a gated relaunch from Game Windows.
Inject an application quit request while an editor is dirty, keep editing once, discard through UI, and verify no unsaved entity appears after restart.

Complete portable round-trip, Chrome transfer, font installation, live Chromium role DOM/Canvas font replacement on the retained macOS AppKit and Windows hosts, diagnostics export, and staged updater installation with native dialogs.
Drive tray, application menu, and native shortcuts through OS automation, including the native entry into the separately covered quit guard.

Launch the Chromium v23 main shell on macOS, prove the isolated preload bridge and Core snapshot are live, and verify Electron's native non-client renderer gesture contract. Retained AppKit game-window/tab evidence remains a separate target requirement.
Launch the Chromium v23 desktop shell on Windows and prove the isolated preload bridge, Core snapshot, and native non-client gesture contract are live.

Drive real macOS Command+N through the retained NSMenu to create one exact empty AppKit Game Window, use visible Quick Access to launch a fixture Role into it, then send Command+Plus, Command+0, and Control+Command+F only to that exact-PID focused runtime window. Prove monotonic exact Core zoom receipts, Core/native/Role-surface factor readback, unchanged main-window zoom/fullscreen state, and stable AppKit host/window/tab identity through zoom, reset, and fullscreen enter/exit.

Drive real Windows Ctrl+N through exact-PID OS input to create one empty bundled-Chromium Game Window, use visible Quick Access to launch a fixture Role into it, then send Ctrl+Plus, Ctrl+0, and F11 only to the exact foreground HWND. Prove monotonic exact Core zoom receipts, Core/native/Role-surface factor readback, unchanged main-window zoom/fullscreen state, and stable bundled-host identity through zoom, reset, and fullscreen enter/exit.

On a live Windows Electron runner, fail closed unless ABI v4 converts the exact Electron-owned surface into one dedicated no-activate WS_CHILD, proves that it owns exactly one WebContentsView under the exact foreground runtime parent, native foreground KeyA and mouse submission produce isolated-preload DOM receipts with isTrusted=true, then the same Role surface remains hidden and unfocused behind a visible sibling while native background KeyB produces trusted DOM receipts without showing, selecting, focusing, or changing the foreground owner.

From a visible global-Web fixture control, open one admitted HTTP(S) popup in the exact parent Session, prove isolated/noopener final navigation plus retained AppKit popup tab/window identity and layout receipts, visibly close the exact native popup tab, then gate a second popup and retire its visible parent tab to prove cancellation and terminal teardown. Lower-layer gates reject nested, POST, external-scheme, stale-parent, and unsupported-disposition requests without a BrowserWindow or HTML-chrome fallback.

From a visible global-Web fixture control, open one admitted HTTP(S) popup in the exact parent Session, prove isolated/noopener final navigation on the exact bundled Chromium native host, visibly close the exact native popup tab, then gate a second popup and retire its visible parent tab to prove cancellation and terminal teardown. Lower-layer gates reject nested, POST, external-scheme, stale-parent, and unsupported-disposition requests.

In the macOS Chromium target, visibly reject an invalid Game URL, create and edit the Game through the Electron renderer, prove Core plus SQLite continuity after process restart, cancel one delete, then visibly confirm deletion. Retained AppKit game-window evidence is outside this main-shell journey.

In the Windows Electron/Chromium target, visibly reject an invalid Game URL, create and edit the Game through the renderer, prove Core plus SQLite continuity after process restart, cancel one delete, then visibly confirm deletion.

Accept the legal documents, dismiss first-run setup, reach the Windows Chromium application shell, and prove the accepted state survives restart.

Navigate every primary product section and return from Settings through the visible Windows Chromium application shell.

Create and edit a Role through visible Electron/Chromium UI, launch it through visible Quick Access into the Windows Chromium host, then prove exact Game ownership, SQLite identity, and native launch again after restart.

Create and edit a mixed Role/Web Workspace through visible macOS Chromium UI, launch its paired Role and Web content from the visible Workspace action into the retained AppKit Chromium host, and prove both slot identities, URLs, native readiness, and launch admission survive a clean process restart.

Create and edit a mixed Role/Web Workspace through visible Windows Chromium UI, launch its paired Role and Web content from the visible Workspace action into the native Chromium host, and prove both slot identities, URLs, native readiness, and launch admission survive a clean process restart.
Reject the reserved Quick Access shortcut, create and edit a Role-bound Macro through visible macOS Chromium UI, and prove its role binding after restart.
Reject the reserved Quick Access shortcut, create and edit a Role-bound Macro through visible Windows Chromium UI, and prove its role binding after restart.

Read-only runtime evidence binds the Role to retained AppKit Chromium without replacing native chrome; the dedicated Chromium native-effect journey owns input delivery.

From the visible Windows Chromium Macro UI, create a Role-assigned delay-only Macro, reject Ctrl+K with the dedicated reserved-shortcut message, prove stable mind-map focus with no node or focused-edge filters, exercise grouped and flat tables plus selection, then start and stop through visible controls before and after restart. Create a Role-assigned KeyA, left, middle, right, and long-delay Macro through visible Windows Chromium UI; open its managed Role, start the Macro visibly, require exact foreground-focus acknowledgement, and require exact trusted keydown/keyup plus button/buttons DOM sequences and semantic click, auxclick, and contextmenu evidence before visibly stopping it. The separate background-tab replacement owns hidden delivery and continuity.

Create a one-shot toggle Macro assigned to Role A with Roles A and B as visible shortcut sources. Hold trusted Digit2 on A, select and operate B while A remains hidden, return to A for exact neutral cleanup, then select B and visibly trigger a second run whose trusted Digit2 reaches hidden A without showing, selecting, or focusing it. Require no Digit2 on B, no residual consumer key or Macro status, exact shared-parent topology, and retained AppKit Chromium identities throughout.

Run the same visible two-Role held-key lifecycle in the Windows Chromium host. ABI v4 attachment plus read-only receipts must prove same-owner Digit2 continuity after A becomes hidden, a fresh trusted Digit2 run started from visible B reaches hidden A without show, select, focus, or activation APIs, B receives no target input, the foreground parent and visible sibling remain unchanged, and cleanup terminalizes every native and Core-held key. The live physical verdict remains independently required on Windows CI.

Start a held-KeyS Macro through the visible Chromium Macro UI, leave its assigned Role hidden behind a second tab in the retained AppKit Game Window, and inject the exact serialized power-suspend signal. Require the Core terminal lifecycle projection, native cleanup keyup and neutral receipt, terminal Macro, and disabled Start while suspended; then inject resume, visibly restart the hidden Role Macro from a new run/input epoch, visibly stop it, and retain exact AppKit host and tab evidence.

Start a held-KeyS Macro through the visible Chromium Macro UI while its bundled-Chromium Role owns required foreground focus, move visibly to a second native tab, and inject the exact serialized power-suspend signal. Require the Core terminal lifecycle projection, native cleanup keyup and neutral receipt, terminal Macro, and disabled Start while suspended; then inject resume, reselect the Role for this standby scenario, visibly restart from a new run/input epoch, visibly stop it, and retain exact Windows native-host and tab evidence.

From visible role content, open and complete a local cross-origin verification iframe while a zero-interval looping macro runs; prove automatic input pauses before native submission, the live document/session and surface generation remain unchanged, and the eligible root restarts once from the beginning when Canvas focus returns. Then arm a navigation failure and use its visible page control to prove a genuinely unresumable role keeps its live AppKit Chromium surface and becomes restart-required.

Use visible native middle-button presses in selected bundled-Chromium roles to exercise toggle and while-held macros while proving mousedown, mouseup, and auxclick remain intercepted from the page; then execute left, middle, and right macro click steps and observe all three trusted native button effects without recursively re-entering the shortcut, with the ABI-v3 physical gate required.

Keep an exact physical Shift side held across managed while-held acknowledgements and AppKit Game Window focus loss; prove focus return reasserts that same still-held side so an unbound Shift+4 remains shifted until physical release, with no Core lease or page key left behind.

Keep an exact physical Shift side held across managed while-held acknowledgements and bundled Game Window focus loss; prove focus return reasserts that same still-held side so an unbound Shift+4 remains shifted until physical release, with no Core lease or page key left behind and the ABI-v3 physical gate required.

Launch a mixed three-slot Workspace containing two AppKit-bound Roles and one Web App, wait for both real Roles to reach authoritative macro readiness, show one looping macro exactly once in its combined two-role group, run it across both Roles with balanced trusted effects through a visible focus change, and stop it from the second Role without deadlock or lost consumer state.

Launch a mixed three-slot Workspace containing two bundled-Chromium Roles and one Web App, wait for both real Roles to reach authoritative macro readiness, show one looping macro exactly once in its combined two-role group, run it across both Roles with balanced trusted effects through a visible focus change, and stop it from the second Role without deadlock or lost consumer state, with the ABI-v3 physical gate required.

Keep a macro attached to shared Role identity through successful AppKit ownership transfer while blocking input to non-target and placeholder occurrences, then prove the transferred exact owner remains eligible after restart.

Keep a macro attached to shared Role identity through successful bundled-Chromium ownership transfer while blocking input to non-target and placeholder occurrences, then prove the transferred exact owner remains eligible after restart, with the ABI-v3 physical gate required.

Capture the original Shift+2 main-key lifecycle in the managed AppKit Role, replay exactly one trusted balanced chord, and dispatch only after guarded acknowledgement; prove the same held physical press cannot re-enter, release permits the next invocation, and no residual key ownership or recursive macro start remains.

Capture the original Shift+2 main-key lifecycle in the managed bundled-Chromium Role, replay exactly one trusted balanced chord, and dispatch only after guarded acknowledgement; prove the same held physical press cannot re-enter, release permits the next invocation, and no residual key ownership or recursive macro start remains, with the ABI-v3 physical gate required.

Keep a one-shot parent visibly stoppable after it triggers a looping child, stop the owned group through the parent's visible Stop action, and terminalize independent loops through retained AppKit tab close, window close, and application Quit while proving exact input-neutrality receipts and clean restart.

Keep a one-shot parent visibly stoppable after it triggers a looping child, stop the owned group through the parent's visible Stop action, and terminalize independent loops through bundled native tab close, window close, and application Close while proving exact input-neutrality receipts and clean restart, with the ABI-v3 physical gate required.

Hold unbound keys while switching retained AppKit tabs and focusing the main app; prove the original Role receives one release, a Shift released outside the Game Window does not affect the next Digit4 after refocus, and no pressed or consumer codes remain.

Hold unbound keys while switching bundled native tabs and focusing the main app; prove the original Role receives one release, a Shift released outside the Game Window does not affect the next Digit4 after refocus, and no pressed or consumer codes remain, with the ABI-v3 physical gate required.
